polityka.intro: For the COACHAY service and app (coachay.com) and its personal data protection rules.

sections.title: 1. General information
sections.body:
1.1. This policy applies to the COACHAY service and app, available at: coachay.com (the "Service").

1.2. The Service operator and the personal data controller for data collected through the Service is the Coachay service operator, Tax ID (NIP): 771-222-88-03.

1.3. Electronic contact address with the Operator: support@coachay.com.

1.4. The Operator is the controller of personal data voluntarily provided in the Service — during registration, creating a team/club, adding players, and in in-app communication (chat, announcements, tasks).

1.5. The Service collects information about users in the following ways:

• through voluntarily entered data (registration, player and coach profiles, attendance, communication),
• by storing cookies on end devices and analogous local storage mechanisms on mobile devices.

sections.title: 2. Data protection methods
sections.body:
2.1. Data transmission between the user's device and the server takes place over an encrypted layer (SSL/TLS) — data entered in the app is encrypted in transit to the server.

2.2. Access to data in the app is role-restricted — players, parents/guardians, coaches, and supporters only see data they're authorized to see within their team/club.

2.3. The Operator regularly updates the software components used to process personal data.

sections.title: 3. Hosting and data processors
sections.body:
3.1. The Service and its database are technically hosted on Google Cloud EMEA Limited servers (Firebase Hosting and Firestore, europe-west region).

3.2. For app access payments, data necessary to complete transactions may be processed by payment operators: Przelewy24 (BLIK/card payments in Poland), Google Play, and the Apple App Store (mobile subscriptions) — each acts as an independent controller or processor for the payment transaction it handles.

sections.title: 4. Your rights
sections.body:
4.1. The controller may share personal data with other recipients where necessary to perform a contract or fulfill the controller's obligations — this applies in particular to the Operator's authorized staff/associates and companies providing hosting and IT support services.

4.2. Personal data will not be kept longer than necessary for the purpose of its processing or as required by law.

4.3. You have the right to request from the controller: access to your data, correction, deletion, restriction of processing, and data portability.

4.4. You have the right to object to the processing of your personal data for the controller's legitimate interests.

4.5. You have the right to lodge a complaint with the President of the Personal Data Protection Office, ul. Stawki 2, 00-193 Warsaw, Poland.

4.6. Providing personal data is voluntary but necessary to use the Service's features (e.g. joining a team, confirming attendance).

4.7. Personal data is not transferred to third countries as defined by data protection law — it is not sent outside the European Union.

sections.title: 5. Data of minor players
sections.body:
5.1. Data of minor players is processed only with the consent of a parent or legal guardian, expressed by a coach adding the player to a team in the app, or a parent joining independently using an access code.

5.2. Player profiles are visible only to coaches assigned to that team and to the player's own parents/guardians — they are not publicly accessible.

5.3. A parent/guardian may at any time request access to, correction of, or deletion of their child's data by contacting the Operator or the team's coach.

sections.title: 6. Cookies
sections.body:
6.1. The Service uses cookies and analogous local storage mechanisms (e.g. localStorage) in the mobile version of the app.

6.2. These files are stored on the user's end device and are used to maintain the user's session and remember their preferences (e.g. selected team, notification settings) — without building a marketing profile of the user.

6.3. The user may change cookie settings in their browser's menu at any time. Restricting their use may affect some Service features (e.g. staying logged in).
